AUTOMAP CDMS and mapping builder

AUTOMAP

Inputs

Add Excel or CSV files. They are read in this browser and never uploaded.

    Process

    A CDMS for your EDC build

    Every EDC field is matched to the reference CDMS, renamed for its form, and each source and target pair receives the mandatory target columns. Fields without a reference are listed separately.

    Mapping files that follow the CDMS

    One Row and Column Level Map per target table. Reference lines and the lines they depend on are reused and renamed, gaps are generated from the CDMS logic, and anything left to write is called out.

    A CDMS checked against the EDC

    Source tables and fields are matched to the EDC, safe corrections are made with the original values recorded, and the analysis shows what still needs a decision.

    Results

    AUTOMAP runs entirely in your browser. No data leaves this computer.
